group.name: Defence (Army, Navy, Air Force, Coast Guard)
group.intro: Defence jobs ke do raaste hain: Agniveer (soldiers, sailors aur airmen ke liye 4 saal ki service) aur officer entries. Caste ke basis par age relaxation aam taur par lagu nahi hota. NDA aur CDS Part 4 mein diye gaye hain. Army, Navy aur Air Force apni-apni eligibility, exam aur physical standards ke saath alag Agniveer recruitment karte hain. Agnipath scheme mein har Agniveer ko exit par lagbhag ₹10.04 lakh (tax-free) ki Seva Nidhi milti hai, aur ek batch ke 25% tak ko regular service ke liye chuna ja sakta hai.
group.ageRelaxation.rows.0.rule: Koi relaxation nahi (Coast Guard chhodkar: +3 saal)
group.ageRelaxation.rows.1.rule: Koi relaxation nahi (Coast Guard chhodkar: +5 saal)
group.ageRelaxation.notes.0: Final-year students aam taur par graduate exams mein apply kar sakte hain, agar notice ki cut-off date tak unke paas degree hogi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.1: Defence entries mein aam taur par caste-based age chhoot nahi milti: har category ke liye same limit hai. Coast Guard iska exception hai aur central chhoot rules follow karta hai.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.2: PwBD candidates kisi bhi defence entry ke liye eligible nahi hain.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.3: Agniveer ki age har service ke notice ki cut-off date par gini jaati hai; Army ke kuch specialist trades mein zyada upper age allowed hai.
